transcribed_from: Research of step 6.7a S2.2a (2026-10-11): IRC/CRC R303.1 and R303.3 (via a building-department handout of the IRC text), CMC Appendix E E605.2 and Title 24 Part 6 150.0(o) / ASHRAE 62.2 (via gocodebook), daylight rule of thumb (ASEE paper), natural-ventilation depth rules (Essex Design Guide).
verification_note: Categories: N = natural light and ventilation required (habitable rooms; bedrooms also need the R310 escape opening), P = natural preferred, mechanical allowed, M = mechanical (artificial light and exhaust; no facade needed). Client decision 2026-10-11: walk-in closets and upper-floor baths may be mechanical so bedrooms always get the best facade. Code values live in crc_2025_habitability (C03) and crc_2025_openings (O06, O07).

parameter_schema.note: Every value the client or the designer may define is a parameter object: value, type (number / enum / list / bool), unit, kind (hard / soft / weight / reference), who (client / designer / code), range (numbers), choices (enum / list), kinds_allowed, optional floor (a code rule the value may not cross) and a description in Spanish and English. The design registry (modules/design) reads them; the client's changes go to a design profile, never here.
